title: Cooktop
prompt: Front-facing editorial photograph of a modern kitchen cooking corner. A plain warm-grey tiled back wall and a white stone countertop whose front edge runs perfectly horizontally across the lower half of the frame. A stainless range hood mounted level above a black built-in gas stove, the entire hood clearly visible in the upper third of the frame with a wide empty margin above it. One black wok on the left burner and one stainless steel pot on the right burner. A wooden spatula and a metal ladle both clearly lying side by side on the counter in front of the stove. A round bamboo steamer with its lid on the counter to the right. A built-in oven below the counter at the far left. Camera level at 20 degrees above horizontal, straight-on parallel projection, countertop front edge horizontal, every vertical edge perfectly vertical, no perspective convergence, no tilted surfaces, no roll, 50mm lens, no wide-angle distortion. All objects fully visible inside the frame with clear gaps, nothing cropped, nothing floating, true-to-life materials and colors, soft natural daylight, crisp detail, no people, no text, no logos.
